long_technical_markdown_doc.text:
# Bimanual Diffusion Policy Optimization for High-Mix 3PL Warehouse Kitting

## 1. Executive Summary & Edge Inference Architecture
At KineDex Robotics (Singapore & Ho Chi Minh City), we deploy bimanual manipulation cells for high-mix 3PL warehouse kitting. Standard PyTorch FP32 diffusion policy checkpoints required 64ms per denoising step on edge hardware, bottlenecking closed-loop visuomotor control at 15Hz.

| Metric | Baseline FP32 | KineDex TensorRT INT8 | Target Hardware |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Inference Latency | 64ms | 18ms | Jetson AGX Orin (64GB) |
| Deformable Polybag Grasp Rate | 93.6% | 93.4% (1,200 picks) | Dual-Arm Cell |

## 2. Active Stereo & Tactile Sensor Fusion under Specular Warehouse Glare
During our live 3PL warehouse pilot in Tuas, Singapore, high-bay LED lighting glare reflecting off shrink-wrapped pallets degraded passive RGB-D depth estimation. By fusing active IR stereo point clouds with high-frequency tactile wrist feedback, our controller recovers contact normals within 4ms and prevents slip on deformable polybags without manual lighting calibration.
